title: Florida's 'dark magic' mushrooms have a deadly combination of chemicals never seen before
caption:
Florida's 'dark magic' mushroom, Galerina indica, is the first ever discovered to contain both psilocybin and deadly amatoxins. Researchers believe this unique genetic combo likely evolved as a double-defense mechanism against predators.

Source: Livescience - Florida's 'dark magic' mushrooms have a deadly combination of chemicals never seen before
